artworks.title: René Laudonnière Sablais (De Burdigale)
artworks.artist: Charles Meryon after Crispijn de Passe I
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a man shown from the chest up within an oval frame. The man is facing forward with distinct facial features, a prominent nose, a pointed mustache, and a beard following his jawline. His hair is short and curly, styled away from his forehead. He wears a high-collared shirt with a decorative pattern visible beneath a doublet featuring puffed sleeves and decorative buttons. The outer frame includes decorations of fruit, vines, and leaves. Text in a stylized font appears above and below the oval frame. The background features detailed textures and lines as part of the etching design.

artworks.title: François Viète
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright, wearing a long, ornate robe with intricate patterns and a detailed collar. His hair is curly, and he has a full beard and mustache. The man is holding a scroll in his left hand with the letters "A + B = C" written on it and gesturing towards his chest with his right hand. The background is plain with an arch shape framing it. At the bottom of the image, there is a decorative coat of arms, and the name "François Viète" is inscribed below. A spherical object is visible on the ground to his left.

artworks.title: Océanie, ilots à Uvea (Wallis); Peche aux palmes, 1845 (Oceania: Fishing, Near Islands with Palms in the Uea or Wallis Group)
artworks.description: The image depicts a waterside scene viewed from a low vantage point above the water surface. Closest to us, there is a body of water with gentle ripples, and several figures are partially submerged as they wade through it. Beyond the water, the horizon line is set low in the composition, revealing a distant ship with sails raised, silhouetted against the sky, and an island densely populated with palm trees to the right. The sky is filled with billowing clouds, rendered with soft, cross-hatched strokes that suggest tenderness in the atmosphere and depth in the scene. The overall color palette is monochrome in sepia tones, lending an air of timelessness to the image and highlighting detailed line work.

artworks.title: Nouvelle-Calédonie: Grande case indigène sur le chemin de Ballade à Poepo, 1845 (New Caledonia: Large Native Hut on the Road from Balade to Puebo, 1845)
artworks.description: The image displays a village scene with a large hut at the center. Surrounding the hut are lush vegetation, including tall palm trees. Figures engaged in daily activities are near the hut, partially hidden by the foliage. The style is reminiscent of etching, with fine and detailed brushstrokes that give texture to the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on shades of brown. In the background, there are hills and mountains, with a sky lightly etched with clouds and birds.

artworks.title: Présentation du Valère Maxime au Rois Louis XI (The Printer Valerius Maximus Being Presented to King Louis XI)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with multiple figures in a historical setting. In the center, a seated figure interacts with another person kneeling before them. Surrounding them are men wearing cloaks and hats. On the right side, a man with a robe and rod walks towards the seated figure, and a child holding a stick observes. The room has a patterned floor and stone-like walls with floral patterns. A doorway is visible in the background.

artworks.title: Rébus: "Ci-gît la vendetta surannée" (Rebus: "Here Lies the Ancient Vendetta")
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 7.9 × 7.5 cm (3 1/8 × 2 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a rebus puzzle. It features a circular frame with a clock-like rim adorned with Roman numerals, surrounding a central rectangular scene. Inside the rectangle, there is an illustration of an individual washing a sheet of fabric in a wooden tub. Above the person are letter 'J's, and below is the word "ANNEX" with alternating black and white rectangular patterns. The word "RÉBUS" is written at the bottom. The drawing has intricate line work resembling engravings or etchings. The date "1er Janvier 1863" and a location note also appear on the image.

artworks.title: Rébus: "Béranger ne fut véritablement fort, car il n'eut jamais la clef des champs" (Rebus: "Beranger was not really strong, for he never had the key of the fields")
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various objects and scenes along with some text. The central elements of the drawing include a bird standing on a patch of ground and a column of poetry comparing the bird to an influential figure. Below that, several sketched images are arranged in a vertical sequence, including wooden posts, a table set with a cloth bearing the text "RESTAURATEUR EN RENOM DU PALAIS ROYAL," and a star-shaped fort labeled "PAYS DES POULARDS." A barrel with the label "PIÈCE DE SALAISON," a solitary figure next to a tree, and various contraptions also populate the image. The bottom portion of the drawing contains a set of arrangements reminiscent of a telescope or a surveying tool alongside a list mentioning various types of chants, including "CHANTS RUSTIQUES ET MARITIMES" and "MARSEILLAISE." The names "VIRGILE" and "HOMERE" are inscribed.

artworks.title: Study for "Le Petit Pont"
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch from an elevated point of view, revealing an industrial or mechanical scene. A structure with wooden beams and wheels is depicted prominently, implying machinery or a pulley system. The surrounding details suggest an industrial complex or landscape. The drawing features thin pencil lines emphasizing linearity and form over detail and shading. The paper is off-white with gray pencil strokes, creating a subtle visual impact. In the bottom right corner, there is a small red square with "PB" inscribed into it.

artworks.title: Study for "Le Petit Pont"
artworks.description: This image is a sketch of a section of a stone building. The perspective is straight-on, focusing on the architectural features. The sketch shows a wall with window openings, including a vertical window and an arched window. The style is basic with rough pencil lines outlining the stones and wall features. The color palette is minimal, with light beige paper and dark pencil lines. Handwritten notes in French are scattered throughout the sketch, likely related to the architectural elements shown.

artworks.title: Study for "Le Petit Pont"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a basic architectural structure. The drawing depicts a simple structure with a flat horizontal top supported by vertical elements. The image is minimalist, with lines providing a rough outline of the object. There are some annotations or letters added to the drawing. The background is a plain surface. The overall sketchiness and the simplicity of the lines suggest it was made to capture the essence of the structure rather than as a finished piece of art.

artworks.title: Chasse-maree au plus pres
artworks.description: The image depicts a pencil sketch showing a sailing ship on gently rippling waters. A distant landform with sparse trees is visible at the horizon. Detailed pencil strokes are used, especially in the rigging and sails of the ship. The color palette is mainly greys due to the medium used. The sky features wispy clouds sketched with light shading, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Tikao, naturel d'Akaroa
artworks.medium: ink and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person's upper body. The individual is depicted facing forward with a serious expression. They have large, curly hair and wear a draped garment around their shoulders. The background is dark and textured.

artworks.title: Moliere's Tomb
artworks.medium: graphite with red chalk additions on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a architectural structure with columns. The image shows a pencil sketch of a rectangular building or structure with columns. The columns are underlined by a lintel or architrave, with outlines of arches or curved lines above. Incomplete lines and sketches are visible, suggesting a preliminary drawing or study. Annotations or handwritten notes are present at the bottom of the drawing.

artworks.title: River Dredges and Lighters
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a small rustic boat with a central cabin-like structure. The drawing is done from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is indicated by faint horizontal lines in the distance. The pencil lines are soft and delicate, showing subtle shades and textures. The overall color palette is soft and subdued, with natural shades of paper and grey tones of the pencil. Close to us, the boat's outlines are more defined, with details like the mast, planks, and additional small boats tethered around. The background is undefined, suggesting open space beyond the main subject.

artworks.title: Seine Boat for "Le Pont-au-Change"
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a ship viewed from a distance, slightly below, and facing it head-on. The lines suggest an open sea setting for the ship. The sketch is created with simple pencil lines, displaying a loose and rough technique that suggests initial studies or a preliminary sketch rather than a finished work. The color palette is virtually absent due to the monochromatic nature of pencil, relying on variations in shading and line density to define form and volume. The ship is the central focus, with its sails and masts suggested rather than detailed, lending an unfinished, airy quality to the composition.

artworks.title: College Henri IV
artworks.medium: graphite with red chalk additions on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch depicting an architectural scene with a Gothic-style tower to the left. A hill and buildings are visible in the background. The drawing shows delicate and precise line work in soft pencil against an off-white paper background. Handwritten annotations at the top indicate the year 1883.

artworks.title: College Henri IV
artworks.medium: graphite with red chalk additions on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing displays a village scene with buildings on the left. The horizon line is suggested by the alignment of rooftops. The sketch is in pencil with fine lines defining the structures, with touches of orange for detail. The color palette is minimal, mostly natural tones and grey with sparse orange accents. Some vegetation and trees are sketched in the foreground. Various rooftops and buildings are outlined more densely in the background. The top of the paper includes inscriptions, annotations, and a faint sketch of two circular shapes.

artworks.title: Boats on River with Masts
artworks.description: The image depicts a pencil sketch of a waterfront scene. Boats are shown at different distances from the viewer, with the horizon high on the page. Faint outlines of structures hint at buildings on the horizon. The boats are intricately detailed with precise lines, while the overall style is subtle and precise, using fine pencil strokes. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray.

artworks.title: La Panne
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed pencil sketch of a ship with two masts, viewed from the side. The drawing provides a clear representation of the ship's structure. The horizon is not distinct, focusing on the ship and the water around it. The sea surface is depicted with wavy lines. The drawing style features precise pencil strokes, detailing the ship's sails, rigging, and hull. The color scheme is monochrome, with shades of gray and black. The sails are partly deployed, and the rigging's complexity is illustrated. The water is represented with curved lines, suggesting light waves. The composition highlights the ship's design and the pencil technique used.

artworks.title: Seated Female Figure for "San Francisco"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a reclining figure beside a pedestal. The image features a sketch of a figure lying down, leaning against a small column or pedestal. The figure appears to be draped in loose fabric, with delicate lines suggesting folds and contours of the material. Behind the figure, there are faint lines hinting at additional forms or structures. The background is plain. The letters "S A S M" are inscribed in faint writing on the pedestal or nearby surface.

artworks.title: Seated Male Figure for "San Francisco"
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a person sitting, with one knee raised and an arm resting on it. The person's other arm is extended behind them. The facial features are minimally detailed, and the hair is sketched with simple strokes. The person appears to be minimally clothed with drapery. The background includes architectural elements like a column or ledge, and the word 'CISCO' is partially visible. The sketch is done with light strokes on a beige paper.

artworks.title: Moliere's Tomb
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mechanical or architectural sketches on aged paper. Various line drawings, shapes, and notations are present throughout the image. The upper left corner contains a flame-like figure, while the top center shows a dome shape with a spout. Horizontal and vertical lines intersect on the page, and there are additional light sketches and hatchings for shading. The simple lines and smudged shading suggest an early conceptual design phase.

artworks.title: Couverture du "Voyage à la nouvelle Zélande" (Cover for the Set of Etchings Entitled "A Voyage to New Zealand")
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a title page for a historical maritime voyage. The image contains intricate line drawings that form an elaborate border around the text. The central text details a voyage to New Zealand, specifically an expedition entitled "Voyage à la Nouvelle Zélande," accomplished between the years 1842 and 1846 onboard the Navire Rhin. The text also mentions command under Captain A. Bérard. The surrounding border includes nautical and exploratory themes, such as depictions of native plant leaves, a fish, and nautical equipment. There is also a strong sense of design symmetry in the illustrated border, which features stylized flora and fauna and includes a date marked as 1866. The paper has a vintage appearance consistent with the historical context of the document's content.

artworks.title: Couverture du "Voyage à la nouvelle Zélande" (Cover for the Set of Etchings Entitled "A Voyage to New Zealand")
artworks.description: The image displays ornate lines and shapes forming an intricate border with swirling, ribbon-like designs. The top section features a wavy line pattern intertwining with small bird-like shapes, resembling architectural columns. At the bottom, fish-like forms are present on either side with stylized waves. The central area is largely plain, with an oval shape hinting at a mirror or frame. The abstract composition resembles a theater stage set with elements reminiscent of maritime motifs and ancient architecture.
